messages:
Priya (CSM): Hey team — NovusAI sent back a vendor risk form. They want clarity on SOC2 scope + embeddings retention + KMS provenance. Need a response by EOD tomorrow.
Samir (Security): I can handle KMS/key provenance. do we have an attestation doc handy?
Asha (Onboarding): I will pull the onboarding evidence bundle and dataflow diagram. may need help redacting screenshots.
Priya (CSM): Customer is also asking whether hosted embeddings can be configured to auto-delete per-tenant.
Samir (Security): short answer: yes. default retention is 30 days; per-tenant retention configurable via control plane. sending config snippet.
Samir (Security): ```
POST /v1/customers/{id}/settings
{ "embeddings_retention_days": 30 }
```
Samir (Security): For keys: Hosted = Redwood-managed keys; Private = BYOK. We should provide standard wording about rotation and access controls.
Lauren (Legal): paste the exact customer question here and I'll check liability language.
Priya (CSM): Copied from form: "Please confirm key provenance, rotation cadence, and access controls for embeddings derived from customer data."
DPA-bot: checklist: [x] SOC2 cert v2024; [ ] KMS attestation; [x] Data flow diagram uploaded; [ ] Customer-facing retention statement drafted.
Asha (Onboarding): Evidence upload: https://redwood.app/s/novusai-evidence (contains dataflow.png, soc2.pdf, onboarding-note.txt)
Priya (CSM): Great — Samir can you draft the KMS paragraph? Lauren will do the legal polish. I'll own sending to the customer.
Samir (Security): Draft: "Redwood manages encryption keys for Hosted deployments. For Private deployments, customers may supply keys via their KMS (BYOK). Access to keys is restricted to authorized systems and personnel, logged in our audit trail. Key rotation is supported and configured per-customer; when using Redwood-managed keys we rotate annually unless a different cadence is agreed in the SLA. See attestation: https://redwood.app/attest/kms"
Lauren (Legal): small tweak: replace "annually" with "as agreed in the customer SLA" and add note about exported audit logs for requests. doing that now.
Lauren (Legal): Updated draft: "...Key rotation is performed as agreed in the customer SLA. Access requests to key material are logged and available for review under our audit process."
Priya (CSM): Perfect. Deadline: send final package to NovusAI by 17:00 PT tomorrow. Owners: Samir = KMS paragraph, Asha = evidence upload & redaction, Lauren = legal signoff.
Asha (Onboarding): noted. I'll verify screenshots and strip any example tenant IDs.
Priya (CSM): Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll queue the email once Lauren confirms the final wording.
DPA-bot: reminder set for 2025-05-15 17:00:00 PT
Samir (Security): Draft uploaded: https://redwood.app/drafts/novusai-kms-answer — feel free to edit.
Lauren (Legal): reviewed and approved. all set from legal.
Priya (CSM): Sending now. I'll post the thread update once customer responds.
_note: Single-thread Slack export. Messages are chronological and prefixed by sender. No title included per agents.md guidance.
